summary_en: Fellowtech Corporation announced a tender offer for all outstanding shares of Japan Resistor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. at 1,901 yen per share, with a minimum purchase target of 618,700 shares (50.27% ownership post-acquisition), over a 30-business-day period from September 18 to November 5, 2026. The target company's board of directors has endorsed the offer and recommended shareholders to tender their shares.
title_en: Notice of Expression of Support and Recommendation for Tender Offer for Shares of Japan Resistor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. by Fellowtech Corporation
translation_en_brief:
Fellowtech Corporation initiated a tender offer for all outstanding ordinary shares of Japan Resistor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. at a purchase price of 1,901 yen per share. The tender offer period runs for 30 business days from September 18, 2026 to November 5, 2026. The minimum number of shares to be purchased is set at 618,700 shares, which would result in Fellowtech owning approximately 50.27% of the company on a fully-diluted basis following the acquisition. No upper limit on the number of shares has been set.

On September 17, 2026, the board of directors of Japan Resistor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. held a meeting and passed a resolution expressing support for the tender offer and recommending that shareholders tender their shares in the offer. The board's approval was granted on the premise that the tender offer would lead to Fellowtech acquiring complete ownership of the company and that the company's shares would be delisted from the stock exchange.

Following the successful completion of the tender offer and related procedures, Fellowtech intends to make Japan Resistor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. its wholly-owned subsidiary. The target company's board of directors reached its decision on the endorsement of this tender offer after consulting with independent directors and auditors who had no conflicts of interest, ensuring the fairness and integrity of the process.
